title: The Devil's Arithmetic

cover.description: Cover of the Puffin Modern Classics edition.
cover.alt: Book cover showing a yellow 6-pointed star on a brown background, with text reading 'Puffin Modern Classics / The Devil's Arithmetic / Winner of hte National Jewish Book Award / Jane Yolen

overview: A teenage Jewish girl finds herself transported from a present-day Seder to a Polish shtetl during World War II, and experiences firsthand the Nazi horrors of the Holocaust and the heroism of its Jewish targets. Jane Yolen's 1988 novel won the National Jewish Book Award in 1989, and was shortlisted for the Nebula Award and the World Fantasy Award.

incidents.description: This novel was one of dozens of books that were {ln:https://www.fox7austin.com/news/leander-isd-pauses-classroom-books-senate-bill-12|pulled from classrooms in the Leander school district}, in what officials called a 'temporary' move.  Officials feared that using the book, which had previously appeared in eighth-grade reading lists, might violate a recently enacted Texas law targeting {ln:https://tfn.org/sb-12-explained/|'programs that reference race, color, ethnicity, gender identity, or sexual orientation'}. Officials reportedly used artificial intelligence to screen for possibly offending titles, but 'final decisions were made by district administrators after a manual review.' Frank Strong, an Austin teacher who co-directs the Texas Freedom to Read project, noted that the book had not been formally challenged by any district parent.  He told the Jewish Telegraphic Agency that {ln:https://www.jta.org/2025/10/03/united-states/texas-school-district-yanks-ya-holocaust-novel-the-devils-arithmetic-after-using-ai-to-detect-dei-content|'Teachers choose books like The Devil’s Arithmetic because students need books like The Devil’s Arithmetic.'}
